cohort: A total of 360 pregnant women with a gestational age of 11 to 13 +6 weeks underwent 3D transabdominal placental volume measurement.
finding: First-trimester placental volume was lower in cases that developed preeclampsia and/or IUGR, but it was not an effective screening tool for these conditions, although it might be used for predicting early onset preeclampsia.
gest_age: 11 to 13 +6 weeks (at time of placental volume measurement)
